Skeleton Soldier.notes: Move-only card (no attack target icon). Bleed applied. Dodge 1. Community FAQ states the ToG errata made it a range 0 attack. Sheet stores Range 1 (melee), DMG Phy 0, Move DMG 2, Bleed.
